approvals.title: Android release signing review
approvals.notes: Owner granted full release execution and all needed approvals in Codex chat. Version 1.2.2+13 supersedes the version 12 store candidate so the submitted artifacts include the reviewer-auth and CI supply-chain security remediations. Fresh APK/AAB hashes, upload-certificate preflight, signature verification, and no exposed signing material remain required.

approvals.title: iOS release scope decision
approvals.notes: Owner expanded the current release authority to include iOS execution, distribution preparation, store inspection, upload, and submission for the complete app scope.

approvals.title: Release-owner go/no-go approval
approvals.notes: Owner explicitly granted full execution and approval of every remaining app task, including computer and authenticated store capabilities. The approval is bound to 1.2.2+13, which supersedes version 12 after security hardening; external provider, physical-device, CI, and store-processing evidence must still be reported separately.

secret_handling: Approval evidence metadata only. Do not add secrets, signing keys, raw SMS bodies, phone/MoMo numbers, service keys, provider tokens, or production customer data.
